Press-Release as of 11.06.1996:

SoundSystem GOLD 16/96 now available:

The biggest selling TerraTec Soundcard is now available in the latest version with even higher user flexibility achieved by complete software configuration (Plug&Play) and considerable enhanced Audiofeatures.

Beyond this, the card developed in Germany, comes up with the now more often requested FullDuplex-Implementation and is therefore of special interest for Internet-/Network-Phone-Apllications.

Furthermore the GOLD 16/96 comes with a built in V-SPACE 3D-Algorythm which allows you to widen the Stereo-Signal, and the ability to equalize the amount of trebble and bass seperately!

When running games, the GOLD 16/96 reponds as an AdLib-, SoundBlaster- and SoundBlaster PRO compatible card- of course without the need for drivers, which means that it offers you bullet-proof performance. Dedicated drivers for Windows 95, Windows NT, OS/2 Warp 3, and Windows 3.1x operating systems are available. It even has a Wavetable-Upgrade-Slot coming with a MPU401-Interface, which allows you to upgrade your Gold 16/96 to a Wavetable-Soundcard!

Last but not least it has an integrated E-IDE-Interface and a variety of audio-connections for the most commonly used CDROM drive-types. The package includes software worth more then 400 DM, for example "MUSIC STATION" (including score-printing), from Steinberg, one of the leading music-software companies in the world, and "CIRCLE ELEMENTS" from the number one German Sample-CD/CDROM supplier. Also inluded are an audiocable and passive speakers.... and of course user-manuals.

The SoundSystem GOLD 16/96 is available from now on for DM 199.- through specialized dealers and retailers.

As usual with TerraTec, a "SE"-Version is available (without Software and Accessories).
This one goes for only DM 149.- (same hardware/driver)

The bottom line:

Plug & Play
enhanced S/N-Ratio
FullDuplex
V- SPACE 3D
compatible
Driversupport
Wavetable upgradable
MPU-MIDI-Interface
E-IDE-Interface
first choice Software
comprehensive accessories
available now!

from DM 149! (only SE-Version; RRP)

For technical Specification and product-picture, please click here.

Press-Release as of 27.05.1996:

Microwave finally installed!

The technical revolution does not even stop at the TerraTec kitchen facilities. After a 4 week-planning-phase and an unanemous decision by the TerraTec staff, the german kitchen-peripheral was connected, activated and up came a new boiling point for the departments of this company.

Side-Effects: The local Pizza-Service had to shut down 3 company cars.
